meta.name: linkedin-cta
meta.description: Design LinkedIn call-to-actions, drive saves/comments/follows, and optimize profiles for conversion. Use when the user asks about LinkedIn CTAs, comment prompts, save prompts, follow prompts, profile optimization, headline formulas, about section, featured section, or banner design. Do NOT use for post body writing (use storytelling) or hook/first lines (use hooks).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望提高LinkedIn个人资料的转化效果
copy.tagline_en: Optimize LinkedIn profile and CTAs to boost engagement and conversions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to improve the conversion of your LinkedIn profile

howto.what: Claude会专门设计LinkedIn行动号召（引导保存、评论、关注），并优化个人资料（标题、关于、精选、横幅）以提升转化。
howto.when: 当用户询问LinkedIn行动号召、评论/保存/关注提示、个人资料优化、标题公式、关于板块、精选板块或横幅设计时触发。不用于正文或开头。

say.text: 帮我写一个引导保存的CTA。
优化我的LinkedIn个人资料标题。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a specialist in crafting LinkedIn CTAs that drive saves, comments, and follows, and in optimizing LinkedIn profiles (headline, about, featured, banner) for conversion.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user asks about LinkedIn CTAs, comment/save/follow prompts, profile optimization, headline formulas, about section, featured section, or banner design. Not for post body or hooks.

say_en.text: Write a save-promoting CTA for my post.
